edit_power_outage_modal_description:
**Accepted date formats**
- `YYYY-MM-dd hh:mm AM/PM` — e.g. `2026-10-08 10:30PM`
- `hh:mm AM/PM` — time only, keeps the current date, e.g. `5:01PM`
Single-digit month/day/hour are also accepted.
edit_power_outage_invalid_date: '{input}' is not a valid date. Use YYYY-MM-dd hh:mm AM/PM or hh:mm AM/PM.
edit_power_outage_invalid_range: Electricity in time must be after the electricity out time.
edit_power_outage_missing_fields: Fill in at least one field to edit this power outage.
edit_power_outage_success: Power outage log '{log_id}' has been updated.
